name: Continued Studies (Mythic)
body:
You reached a complete mastery of your previous class abilities.

Prerequisite(s): Continued Studies.

Benefit(s): You can gain new abilities related to the feature you selected with Continued Studies as you advance in level (new oracle revelations, magus arcana, bardic performances and so on). You also use your character level as your class level in order to qualify for feats that have the selected class feature as a prerequisite.

Special: You may select Mythic Continued Studies once for each time you selected the non-mythic Continued Studies feat.
